scenario: Two error validations for the SAME product (stock.max and not_found) are deduped to ONE blocker, with not_found winning the priority -- the guest is never shown two contradictory reasons for one item.
rubric: Grouping is by productId alone, not by code+productId -- grouping by the pair would make the priority unreachable (two codes are two groups by construction, so not_found could never outrank anything). Exactly one blocker survives, and it is the higher-priority code.
